name: Dustiness Ford Lalatina
original_name: ダスティネス・フォード・ララティーナ
source:
Darkness is a 18-year-old crusader who possesses powerful offense and defense, but lacks the accuracy to deliver her attacks. She is a masochist who dreams of being ravaged by monsters or married to an abusive husband; regardless, she becomes serious with issues involving her friends. She is a noble from the influential Dustiness family, who became a crusader against her father's wishes.

[From Wikipedia]
